Build the matched comparison data in one call

Source: R/match-pipeline.R
build_match_data.Rd

Runs the matching steps in order: the full 990 panel (get_panel()), the research sample of mergers with a full observation window (merger_sample()), the Schedule N organizations to keep out of the pool (schedule_n_events()), the comparison pool (match_pool()), match candidates for each matching specification (match_candidates()), and balance checks (match_balance()).

Usage

build_match_data(
  merger_data,
  panel = NULL,
  years = efile_years(),
  path = "PANEL990",
  types = "merger2",
  pre = 2L,
  post = 2L,
  years_back = 2:3,
  exclude_window = -3:2,
  health = c(margin = "MARGIN", equity = "EQUITY_RATIO"),
  ntee_chars = 2L,
  size = c("REAL_ASSETS", "REAL_EXPENSES"),
  size_caliper = log(2),
  health_caliper = c(MARGIN = 0.1, EQUITY_RATIO = 0.15, MONTHS_CASH = 3),
  max_year_gap = Inf,
  balance_k = c(1L, 5L),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

merger_data

The list from build_merger_data() (needs cases; sched_n and transactions are used to keep merging organizations out of the pool).

panel

A panel from get_panel(). If NULL, it is built from years and path, which reads every 990 filer and takes several minutes.

years, path, verbose

Passed to get_panel() when panel is NULL.

types, pre, post, years_back

Passed to merger_sample() (and pre, post, years_back to match_pool()).

exclude_window

Passed to match_pool().

health

Named character vector of profitability or fiscal-health measures. Each one is a separate specification with its own candidate table, named after the element (default: margin = "MARGIN", equity = "EQUITY_RATIO").

ntee_chars, size, size_caliper, health_caliper, max_year_gap

Passed to match_candidates().

balance_k

Numbers of closest candidates to check balance for.

Value

A list of class merger_match_data:

  • panel, sample, baseline, treated, events, pool;

  • candidates: a named list with one candidate table per health specification;

  • balance: match_balance() results for each specification and k;

  • coverage: per specification, treated units, units with at least 1, 5, and 25 candidates, the mean and median number of candidates, and the share of pairs in the same calendar year;

  • settings: the arguments used.

See also

vignette("matching", package = "npmerger")

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
md <- build_merger_data(years = efile_years())
mm <- build_match_data(md, path = "PANEL990")
mm$coverage
# the five closest comparison org-years for each recipient
mm$candidates$margin[RANK <= 5]
} # }
